Focused on optimizing real-time decisioning frameworks and driving innovation in programmatic advertising infrastructure.

- **Project Management**: Delivered $2M cloud migration initiative ahead of schedule, achieving 40% cost savings through resource optimization and 50% faster query response times in ad inventory management.
